name: Gic (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, yellow at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gic: a crowned yellow shield with a green lion, with a helm and red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gic arms with crown, helm and mantling
